sources.snippet: LTX-2.3 is the previous LTX release. Open weights, synchronized audio, and native portrait video. Still fully supported. LTX-2.5 is the current model.

sources.title: GitHub - desktop-LTX/LTX-2.3: LTX-2.3 is an open-source generative ...
sources.snippet: LTX-2.3 is an open-source generative video architecture based on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT). The model delivers commercial-grade generation quality (on par with Google Veo 3) but without the strict limitations of closed ecosystems. The project supports both fully autonomous local inference and hybrid cloud processing.

sources.title: LTX-2: Production-Grade AI Video Generation Model | LTX
sources.snippet: LTX-2 is a pro AI video model for production. It offers precise control, native 4K, high frame rates and proven performance for long-form creative tasks.
